transcript.text: Hi everyone. The usage-based billing meter has passed its sandbox integration tests, and we're targeting next month's billing cycle for launch. The current draft plan on the table proposes an immediate broad launch, two-decimal half-up rounding, 90 days of raw usage-event retention, and no mandatory invoice-preview review. As part of the normal signoff process, I need to check with billing engineering, finance operations, privacy, and customer support before I can give final approval. I'd like to hear from each of you on whether you see any concerns with this plan before I make my decision. Who'd like to start?

This finding has not yet been added to the launch checklist, and I think it needs to be addressed before we proceed.
